git.pushMessage: git push is blocked. The user pushes manually.
git.confirmPushMessage: Confirm the push: check repository, branch and remote.
git.deletePushMessage: Deleting remote refs needs two confirmations. Ask the user in the chat, then run the same command again.
git.confirmDeleteMessage: Second confirmation: this deletes refs on the remote.
git.refsMessage: Writing remote refs is equivalent to a push and is blocked. The user pushes manually.
git.attributionMessage: The message must not carry agent attributions. Remove the Co-Authored-By / Generated with line and try again.
git.confirmMessage: Confirm the commit: check repository, branch and message.
git.commitFileMessage: Use git commit -m. With -F/--file the message cannot be reviewed before committing.
